name: otp-boxed-input
title: OTP Boxed Input
description: A one-time-code field of separate boxes with paste, arrow-key navigation, error state and a resend countdown.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the sanitized code on every edit.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called once when every box is filled.

props.name: inputMode
props.description: Digits only, or letters and digits (upper-cased).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every box and the resend button.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the first box on mount.

props.name: error
props.description: Marks the code as wrong and shows errorMessage.

props.name: hint
props.description: Replaces the default 'We sent a code to…' line.

props.name: destination
props.description: Where the code was sent, shown in the default hint.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Text shown under the boxes when error is true.

props.name: resendCooldown
props.description: Seconds before the resend button unlocks.

props.name: onResend
props.description: Called when the resend button is pressed.
